title: Should Schools Ban Phones?
text:
Many people think that schools should ban mobile phones during lessons. They believe phones distract students and make it hard to focus. In addition, some teachers say that students spend too much time on social media. For these reasons, a ban could help students learn better.

However, some people disagree with this idea. They argue that phones are useful in emergencies and for research in class. Therefore, schools should teach students to use phones responsibly instead of banning them completely.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do many people believe?
options: Phones should be banned during lessons
Teachers should use phones more often
Schools have no problems with phones

questions.text: What do some people say phones are useful for?
What can be inferred about the writer's view on a complete phone ban?
options: The writer thinks a complete ban may not be the best solution
The writer thinks phones should be used in every lesson
The writer believes teachers never use phones
The writer thinks students are never distracted by phones

questions.text: Why might teachers want to ban phones in lessons?
options: They want students to buy new phones
They believe phones make it harder for students to focus
They want to test phones during class
They do not like the school's Wi-Fi

vocabulary.definition: to take someone's attention away from something
serious situations that need immediate action
in a careful and sensible way
to have a different opinion from someone

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas acham que as escolas deveriam proibir celulares durante as aulas. Elas acreditam que os telefones distraem os alunos e dificultam a concentração. Além disso, alguns professores dizem que os alunos passam tempo demais nas redes sociais. Por essas razões, uma proibição poderia ajudar os alunos a aprender melhor.

No entanto, algumas pessoas discordam dessa ideia. Elas argumentam que os telefones são úteis em emergências e para pesquisas em sala de aula. Portanto, as escolas deveriam ensinar os alunos a usar os telefones de forma responsável, em vez de proibi-los completamente.
